subject: Trading
title: Types of Stops
description: A quick, practical guide to Types of Stops.

hook.text: Percentage stop, dollar stop, technical stop, time stop—there are many ways to define your exit. Each has trade-offs.

buildup.text: A percentage stop exits after a fixed % decline. A dollar stop exits after a fixed dollar loss per share.

discovery.text: Technical stops place the exit below a support level or a pattern boundary—using the chart's structure.

twist.text: A time stop exits if nothing happens: 'If this trade doesn't move in 3 days, I'm out.' It frees up capital.

climax.text: Technical stops are generally best because they're based on market structure, not arbitrary numbers.

punchline.text: The best stop is the one the market respects.

quiz.question: What is a time stop?
